clauses.description: Discrete individually-assessable policy sections/clauses. Same shape as Regul.ai EXTRACTION_TOOL_SCHEMA (record_clauses). Segment internal policy manuals into sections a compliance officer can map on their own. Preserve official numbering (e.g. 3.2, 4.1.1). Go to the DEEPEST enumeration level: if section 2.3 has sub-points (a)(b)(i), emit 2.3-a, 2.3-b — never one merged 2.3 summary. Full verbatim clause_text — do not summarize obligation body text. Skip preambles, revision history, and admin-only text unless they impose an obligation. EXCEPTION: entire annexes/typology/red-flag illustrative lists are ONE clause per annex group (summarize the group; do not split every example). Every clause_no must be unique; invent -a, -b suffixes when needed.

clause_no.description: Official section/clause number, e.g. 3.2 or 4.1.1 or 2.3-a

clause_text.description: Full text of this individually-assessable section — verbatim for obligations, not summarized

source_page.description: 1-indexed PDF viewer page where this section starts; use 0 if unknown
